source: Okamoto Machine Tool Works results presentation: Results briefing for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (06-15-2026)

Okamoto Machine Tool Works.why: Its Semiconductor Equipment segment sells wafer final polishers and grinders and is developing grinders / polishers for advanced packaging (PLP), so wafer and packaging capex drives its orders.
Okamoto Machine Tool Works.evidence: FY results presentation (06-15-2026): mid-term strategy to maintain share in Si wafer polishers and develop polishers / grinders and PLP processing equipment

players.product: Final polishers and grinders for silicon wafer production and compound semiconductor processing; processing equipment for panel-level packaging (PLP) in development

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works results presentation: Results briefing for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 2026: net sales JPY 42,513 million (-2.8%), operating profit JPY 1,518 million (-49.6%); semiconductor equipment sales were above the prior year, with final polishers and grinders for compound semiconductor processing and wafer production sold to Japan and East Asia; capex JPY 5,345 million, planned JPY 2,725 million for the fiscal year ending March 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 42,513 million net sales; JPY 1,518 million operating profit; JPY 5,345 million capex

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works results presentation: Results briefing for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor equipment mid-term strategy: maintain share in polishers for Si wafers; develop polishers and grinders for advanced Si wafer processing, power semiconductor (SiC, GaN) and LT/LN communication-device wafers, and processing equipment for PLP (panel-level packaging); build a production system to support semiconductor equipment sales of 300 (JPY 100 million units).
quarterly_data.figure: 300 (JPY 100 million units) semiconductor equipment sales target

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works results presentation: Results briefing for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Okamoto is developing grinders and polishers with automatic transfer and cleaning for introduction into device processes, including models for 515X510mm and 600mm panels (PLP); new grinder and polisher demand is expected in areas such as CMP removal of unneeded films in wiring-layer formation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Okamoto Machine Tool Works results presentation: Results briefing for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (06-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The Tokyo Technical Center (showroom and technology development building, Saitama) began operation in December 2025 for demonstrations and test processing; in Kyushu the company is building a production system for grinders for high-hardness materials at subsidiary Yamato Koki using a large cleanroom.
